verdict.rationale: Vonage Video is an API-first platform. Its docs show core functions handled programmatically through server-side SDKs: creating sessions, setting media mode and archive mode, and registering event callbacks. However, nothing documents that every dashboard or portal action, or the low-code/no-code offering, has an API equivalent. missing for 10: explicit API/UI parity statement, evidence that account and project management (callback registration, keys, settings) is available via API, independent corroboration of parity.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can do everything through the API that I can do in the UI

citations.quote: The platform includes client libraries for the web, mobile and desktop platform as well as server-side SDKs.
When you create a session, you specify how clients in the session will send audio-video streams, known as the media mode.
When you create a session, you can set the archive mode so that the session is archived automatically.
Server endpoints can also register to receive HTTP requests triggered by stream activity on all sessions for a given project.
